movelist.name: Ominous Wind
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Stored Power
movelist.effect: For every Combat Stage the user has above 0, add +2 to Stored Power’s Damage Base, up to a maximum of Damage Base 20.

movelist.name: Teleport
movelist.effect: The user Teleports up to X meters, where X is its Teleporter Capability. Teleport can be used as an Interrupt at any time. Moves that targeted Teleport’s user continue through the desired target’s space if the Move allows for it as if the user hadn’t been there; single target moves simply miss.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Night Shade
movelist.effect: The target loses Hit Points equal to the level of Night Shade’s user. Do not apply weakness or resistance. Do not apply stats.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.effect: The foe which caused the Status Condition is given the same Status they inflicted.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.effect: The user gains a bonus to Initiative equal to half its Speed, and a +3 Bonus on Save Checks against Sleep.
